scenarios.when: the user asks to initialize Pure Tokens Skills, check whether the current configuration works, or learn how to use the Skills
scenarios.then: invoke init once: fixed public identity followed by one authenticated catalog read; distinguish credential_verified from identity, show usage and never expose configuration

scenarios.when: init cannot resolve a verified credential, cannot reach the fixed API, receives an API rejection, or receives an unconfirmed identity
scenarios.then: state that configuration verification is incomplete, show the executor's sanitized status, message, next action, and only a returned non-zero HTTP status, then still show the usage guide; do not modify configuration, claim media availability, or expose host configuration

scenarios.when: the active host cannot be identified as Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, or Trae
scenarios.then: Ask which supported host the user is using; do not guess the host or its configuration/Skill directory.

scenarios.when: no local terminal, PowerShell, exec, or shell execution is available
scenarios.then: state that local synchronization cannot run in this session and direct the user to give the official repository installation prompt to a terminal-capable local Agent; do not invent a manual copy command or claim success

scenarios.when: an official Skill install or update is requested
scenarios.then: use the current host's available official GitHub repository retrieval mechanism to obtain a fresh local checkout of https://github.com/PureTokens/puretokens-skill main, then run the matching native source-only Shell or PowerShell sync script from that checkout with the current supported host ID. Do not use an installed older updater, a stale checkout, a third-party mirror, a custom install payload, or a remote-content pipe into a shell.

scenarios.when: the current host cannot retrieve a fresh official main checkout or cannot execute its native source-only sync script
scenarios.then: report that local synchronization cannot be completed in this host session and stop before changing installed Skills. Do not install or require Node, npm, Git, dependencies, generators, or a custom install payload.

scenarios.when: the fresh official checkout cannot be statically validated before sync
scenarios.then: report the validation failure and stop before changing installed Skills. Do not run Node, npm packages, generators, docs sync, formatters, repair commands, Git writes, or any other source-mutating command to make the official checkout pass.

scenarios.when: the host interrupts, times out, or otherwise returns before the installer prints the exact synchronized-version completion receipt
scenarios.then: state that synchronization is unconfirmed and do not claim an update, infer a version, automatically retry, or create a background task. On the user's next explicit request, run one fresh official sync.

scenarios.when: a current or retired target directory is missing the matching managed Skill markers
scenarios.then: report the exact conflict and stop before changing any target directory; do not overwrite, delete, rename, or merge it

scenarios.when: a verified retired managed Skill directory or an older hidden retired backup is present in the target root
scenarios.then: after all current official Skills install or upgrade successfully, delete that verified retired directory so the host cannot continue discovering it; never delete an unmanaged directory

install exactly one checksum-verified platform native executor in .puretokens-executor. If the target also contains .puretokens-runtime, remove it only when both old official files are present and runtime.json identifies puretokens-direct-api-runtime; otherwise leave it untouched.

scenarios.when: the target is Codex's ~/.agents/skills and the official Codex plugin list contains the exact legacy puretokens-media plugin
scenarios.then: before synchronizing Skills, remove only the exact listed plugin selector through the official Codex plugin interface, then list plugins again and require that puretokens-media is absent; never read plugin configuration or remove another plugin

scenarios.when: the Codex CLI cannot inspect, remove, or verify removal of the legacy plugin, including workspace-managed plugin cases
scenarios.then: If plugin inspection is unavailable, report that limitation and continue normal installation. If a legacy plugin was actually discovered but cannot be removed and verified, stop migration and guide its removal in Codex Plugins.

scenarios.when: the exact legacy puretokens-media plugin was removed and verified
scenarios.then: require a full Codex application restart, then a brand-new conversation before testing; an existing conversation can retain the already-loaded legacy Skill instructions

scenarios.when: a supported host has no conflicting target directories
scenarios.then: run the official sync command once, report every installed or upgraded Skill and the synchronized official version, then tell the user to start a new host conversation
